cites.quote: then the order is dr. zed, Dr. Amy, dr. bob.
Entries with slot: null come last, ordered by name ignoring case.
Wherever entries are ordered by doctor name, names compare ignoring case

findings.text: S-3 AC4 cannot catch a case-sensitive name sort for null-slot entries. 'Dr. Amy' sorts before 'dr. bob' with or without case. No AC checks the doctor-id tie-break for null-slot entries either, though REQ-17 applies wherever entries are ordered by name.

cites.quote: D's only FREE slots are on 2026-10-26 (one day past today+6)
D's only FREE slots are on 2026-10-25 (today+6)
The window runs from now until the end of the 6th day after today in the hospital time zone

findings.text: S-2 AC1/AC2 do not give the time of the boundary FREE slots. A now+7x24h window ends at 08:00 local on 2026-10-26. It passes AC2 when that day's slots are after 08:00, so the end-of-today+6 boundary goes untested.

cites.quote: An appointment called off before it took place, with a reason; its slot becomes free again.
Given D's first slot of the window is BOOKED and the next slot that date is FREE

findings.text: No AC covers a slot whose appointment was Cancelled. That slot is free again and must be returned. An implementation that treats any appointment as taking the slot passes every AC in S-1, and S-5 has no Cancelled case for the day schedule.
